hypotheses.question: Do intraday trades aligned with the daily trend have a larger edge than intraday trades that are not?
Is the baseline edge above zero on all data?
Is the baseline edge above zero on sessions no earlier evaluation saw?
Same as H3 using the next higher timeframe (5m→15m, 15m→1h, 1h→daily).
Do trades whose other three timeframes all agree beat the rest?

scorecard.reading: A handful of "better" cells is expected by chance when many are tested; treat an isolated one as a lead for later sessions, not a finding.

variants.name: no_chase_filter_off
variants.note: Allows entries that close outside the band (no-chase filter off).

variants.name: unrestricted_sequence
variants.note: Allows every pullback in a trend, not only the 1st and 2nd.

variants.name: partial_runner
variants.note: Takes half at the target and runs the rest to a 2x target.

variants.name: line_stop
variants.note: Puts the stop at the trendline instead of below the structure.

variants.name: research_stop_target_only
variants.note: Exits only at the stop or target, never on a close through the line.

assumptions.execution_eligible: assumed True for research (stored prices carry no verified provider delay)
assumptions.shortable: assumed True for research; long-only results reported separately
assumptions.note: Assumptions make paper fills possible; they are not verified execution or borrow data.

method.unit: R = net P&L per share / initial risk (fill to frozen stop)
method.control: 20 random-timing twins per trade inside the same segment, full holding window observable: same direction, stop/target in ATR, costs and borrow; borrow accrues only until the actual exit
method.intervals: edge 95% CI bootstrapped by symbol (verdict); by-trade CI and minimum detectable edge reported alongside
method.periods: per timeframe, the last 30% of the covered span is a RETROSPECTIVE holdout (already visible to earlier runs); nothing is fitted on either period; unseen evidence requires later sessions
method.fills: next bar open with half-spread + slippage; stop before target; gaps fill at the worse open
method.tuning: none; all variants reported; research_stop_target_only is NOT a live default
